Andrej Kramaric.note: Kramarić's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Andrej Kramaric.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ante Budimir.note: Budimir's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Ante Budimir.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Dominik Kotarski.note: Kotarski's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Dominik Kotarski.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Dominik Livakovic.note: Livaković stands out for the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Dominik Livakovic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是耐心判断点球手最后一下动作。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Duje Caleta-Car.note: Ćaleta-Car's edge is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Duje Caleta-Car.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Igor Matanovic.note: Watch Matanović for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Igor Matanovic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ivan Perisic.note: Watch Perišić for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Ivan Perisic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Ivor Pandur.note: Pandur stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Ivor Pandur.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Josip Stanisic.note: Watch Stanišić for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Josip Stanisic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Josip Sutalo.note: Šutalo's edge is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Josip Sutalo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Josko Gvardiol.note: Gvardiol stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Josko Gvardiol.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Kristijan Jakic.note: Jakić is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Kristijan Jakic.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Luka Modric.note: Modrić is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Luka Modric.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Luka Sucic.note: Sučić's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Luka Sucic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Luka Vuskovic.note: Vušković is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Luka Vuskovic.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marco Pasalic.note: Pašalić's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Marco Pasalic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Marin Pongracic.note: Pongračić is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Marin Pongracic.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mario Pasalic.note: Pašalić's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Mario Pasalic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Martin Baturina.note: Baturina's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Martin Baturina.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Martin Erlic.note: Erlić's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Martin Erlic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mateo Kovacic.note: Kovačić is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mateo Kovacic.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Nikola Moro.note: Watch Moro for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nikola Moro.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Nikola Vlasic.note: Vlašić stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Nikola Vlasic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Petar Musa.note: Musa stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Petar Musa.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Petar Sucic.note: Sučić stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Petar Sucic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Toni Fruk.note: Fruk stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Toni Fruk.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。
